pix/host/envsetup._prod_loc_note: New L2 package: the environment [[setup]] hook runner (check, apply, check again) plus the executable-identity proof (HashSetupExecutable) both the trust bill and the pre-exec re-proof take. It owns the resolved-hook type so the fingerprinted value and the executed value cannot drift. TOCTOU close + `inputs`: a private, per-hook 0700 execution snapshot (takeSnapshot/copyVerified/mismatchError) re-verifies the executable AND every declared companion input's content in the SAME read that copies its bytes (hosttrust.ReadVerifiedFile), and check/apply/postcheck now execute ONLY the snapshot's copied bytes with the snapshot root as cwd. Adds ProveContained (EvalSymlinks-based containment proof for a relative command or input), the HookInput type, and a sys.TerminalSafe pass over captured check output before it is ever rendered. +1 edge (pix/host/sys), +2 exports (ProveContained, HookInput), +1 global (boundedBuffer's new sync.Mutex).

pix/host/release._prod_loc_note: Final security findings (defense in depth): Manifest.Version was checked only for non-empty, yet flows unquoted into a filesystem path (RuntimeDir, extractRuntimeArchive's tar-entry prefix). Added versionRE + validateVersion — a conservative, semver-compatible [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]* grammar refusing slash, backslash, dot-segments, and control characters — wired into Manifest.Validate (the one gate ParseBundleManifest/Parse both already call), so a traversal-shaped version is refused before any archive is staged.
